explanation:
The central tree retains the boundary's major components and service dependencies while shrinking from 148 to 101 lines (31.8%) and from 10,708 to 7,178 characters (33.0%). Five peripheral trees expand resource ownership, MCP scope and write classification, chat visibility, live transport state, and evaluation data dependencies. Edges attach to the relevant concepts rather than arbitrary tree roots. Positions account for actual text dimensions and leave gaps.

The decomposition combines modular structure with call paths, ownership and data dependencies. Evidence comes only from the supplied point, seed and pinned source text. The lifetime tree follows bootstrap.ts and vitePlugin.ts; scope follows apiAccess.ts, agentRoutes.ts and infrastructure/mapping/mcp/server.ts; chat follows agentChatRoutes.ts; live follows liveCanvasRoutes.ts; evaluation follows bootstrap.ts and evalRoutes.ts.

Source-grounded corrections: bootstrap also exposes diffSessionWorkflows and pushIntegrations. Chat projection removes generation.history specifically, not all retained conversation history. Socket binding occurs on attach/publish messages; the implementation does not require the literal first received frame to establish a role. Final diagram-tool validation applies whenever there is no chat binding, including explicitly targeted connections. The comparison generation tool is named generate-diagram-comparisons. The peripherals also show details absent from the seed: fake comparison runtime selection, context source resolution, MCP readOnlyHint versus the narrower HTTP POST allowlist, context-request serialization, weak ETag matching, and evaluation response projections.

Imported service implementations and comparison/push/diff handlers are not supplied. Their internal persistence, authorization and execution guarantees remain unverified. MCP retry guidance is shown as an advertised contract, not proof of service-level idempotency.

diagrams.ascii:
HTTP and MCP Boundary
|-- Composition root: createBackend chooses and connects concrete integrations
|   |-- Chooses concrete stores, runtimes and application services
|   |-- Shared canvas machinery: bridge, agent, live readers and chat
|   |-- Connects generation, persistence, proposals and evaluation
|   `-- Exposes routes, liveCanvas, diffSessionWorkflows, pushIntegrations and dispose()
|       `-- Vite HTTP server close -> dispose sockets, services, bridges and runtimes
|-- HTTP entry: diagramApi mounts the application boundary
|   |-- Installs the same middleware in Vite development and preview servers
|   |-- Request dispatch
|   |   |-- Outside /api and /internal -> next middleware
|   |   |-- /api/core/... -> createCoreRoutes
|   |   |-- /api/mapping/... -> createMappingRoutes
|   |   `-- Other intercepted paths, including /internal/... -> 404
|   |-- Programmable tool write gate: isAgentMutationRequest
|   |   |-- Applies only to /api/mapping/agent/tools/...
|   |   |-- GET/HEAD/OPTIONS and six named POST reads bypass mutation classification
|   |   `-- Other tool requests require httpEnabled=true or a chat-binding header
|   |       |-- Otherwise -> 403 HTTP_WRITES_DISABLED
|   |       `-- App persistence/sync routes remain available; bound calls resolve in the service
|   `-- Transport helpers: readBody, sendJson and sendEvent
|       |-- readBody -> UTF-8 JSON; empty body becomes {}; invalid JSON throws
|       |-- Body limits: 10 MiB default; workspace operations and canvas replies use 64 MiB
|       |-- sendJson -> status + application/json + response end
|       |-- sendEvent -> one JSON record followed by LF
|       `-- Uncaught route failure -> typed HTTP status before headers; otherwise 400
|           `-- After headers: write an error record, then end if still writable
|-- HTTP application surface: injected services behind core/mapping route factories
|   |-- /api/core/project -> source and catalog services [source]
|   |   |-- GET files/source -> ProjectSourceService
|   |   |-- POST definitions -> enabled language lookup; response close aborts lookup
|   |   `-- Projections, corpus-compactions and representations -> catalog/CoreApplication
|   |-- /api/mapping/agent -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService [live-agent, changes]
|   |   |-- POST tools/{name}, if registered in agentToolSchemas
|   |   |   |-- String x-canvas-chat-binding -> service.callBound(token, name, input)
|   |   |   `-- Otherwise -> service.call(name, input)
|   |   |-- Browser contracts: attachments, diagram-edits, cancel and proposal acceptance
|   |   |-- Change sessions: list/read, versioned preview and treemaps, accept
|   |   |-- Canvas bridge: list/register/unregister, poll commands, deliver replies
|   |   `-- Local failures -> 409 conflicts, 503 unavailable, 413 oversized, otherwise 400
|   |-- Workspace and diagrams [persistence]
|   |   |-- GET/PUT workspace -> load/save
|   |   |-- GET/POST workspace/records -> load records/apply batch
|   |   |-- POST workspace/export or import-contexts -> portable export/prepare import
|   |   `-- POST diagrams or diagrams/publish -> save/publish checkpoint; DELETE diagram -> delete
|   |-- Chat and generation [generation]
|   |   |-- /chat -> LocalChatService; /compactions -> FileCompactionService
|   |   |-- POST /prompt -> SelectionService.prepare -> run -> streamed progress/result
|   |   `-- /agent-chat -> AgentChatService
|   |       |-- Sessions: create/list/read/resume; send/read-canvas/reload-tools/interrupt/answer
|   |       |-- Generation: list, gen-alternatives and cancel-generation
|   |       `-- Bound tools: GET definitions; POST calls with input and callId
|   |-- Change intake [changes]
|   |   |-- /workflows/diff-session-create... -> DiffSessionWorkflowService handler
|   |   `-- /integrations/... -> PushIntegrationService handler with configured push token
|   `-- Evaluation and comparison [evals]
|       |-- /evals/prompts, prompt-snapshots, references, reference-groups -> evidence/configuration
|       |-- POST /evals/runs and /roll-ups -> HTTP 202; read/cancel/manage runs
|       |-- /compare-sessions and /comparison-runs -> comparison handlers
|       `-- /generated-canvases -> list generated canvases or migrate through EvalRunService
|-- Streaming and live transport
|   |-- Selection response: POST /api/mapping/prompt
|   |   `-- application/x-ndjson -> progress records -> result record -> end
|   |-- Chat events: GET /api/mapping/agent-chat/sessions/{id}/events
|   |   |-- SSE public snapshots/events; identity encoding; heartbeat every 15 seconds
|   |   `-- Response close -> clear heartbeat and unsubscribe
|   |-- Live HTTP reads: /api/mapping/live
|   |   |-- GET context/short -> workspace/document context + epoch/version headers; no-store
|   |   `-- GET connections/{id}/selection -> selection + sequence/version/time headers
|   |       `-- ETag matches If-None-Match -> 304
|   `-- WebSocket upgrade: /api/mapping/live -> LiveCanvasService
|       |-- Origin absent or same host required; at most 1024 clients
|       |-- JSON text frames; 8 MiB inbound limit; schema validation
|       |-- Binding messages establish one role per socket
|       |   |-- attach -> external reader for workspace/document -> attached event
|       |   `-- publish -> browser publisher -> publisher.ready, protocolVersion 2
|       |-- httpEnabled controls copy/paste and agent-context upload permissions
|       `-- Owns handshake timers, heartbeat, queue limits and connection cleanup
`-- MCP adapter: translates tools into calls to the same HTTP services
    |-- Startup: URL and optional canvas/document IDs from CLI or environment
    |   |-- Backend URL from first argument or MAPPING_URL; requires HTTP(S)
    |   |-- Optional --canvas/--document or environment IDs; both IDs required together
    |   `-- startMappingMcpServer -> register tools -> StdioServerTransport
    |-- Agent tools: names and schemas from agentToolSchemas
    |   |-- Tool call -> POST /api/mapping/agent/tools/{name}
    |   |   `-- JSON body, optional x-canvas-chat-binding, 65-second timeout
    |   |-- Connection scope
    |   |   |-- Unbound -> caller lists/attaches canvas and supplies sessionId
    |   |   |-- Explicit target without chat binding -> cached lazy canvas.attach via exec
    |   |   `-- Chat binding -> optional sessionId; backend resolves the bound call
    |   |-- Diagram tools adapt single/batch schemas; no chat binding -> final validation
    |   `-- Instructions tell callers to reuse identical arguments/requestId for uncertain retries
    |-- Additional HTTP-backed tools
    |   |-- generate-roll-up -> POST /api/mapping/evals/roll-ups
    |   |-- read-eval-run -> GET /api/mapping/evals/runs/{runId}
    |   |-- generate-diagram-comparisons / read-diagram-comparison-run -> comparison-runs
    |   `-- list-compare-candidates -> GET /api/mapping/compare-sessions/candidates
    |-- Bound chat tools: fetch host schemas; register chat_{name}; forward binding/callId
    `-- HTTP result -> MCP text containing JSON
        |-- HTTP success -> also structuredContent: {result}
        `-- HTTP failure or exception -> isError: true

Backend composition and lifetime
|-- createBackend constructs shared dependencies
|   |-- DiagramStore.storeRoot anchors file-backed stores
|   |-- GenerationCanvasBridge owns a CanvasSessionBridge reference
|   |-- LiveCanvasService obtains context via bridge.dispatch
|   `-- Agent + chat + change services share that bridge
|-- Context evidence resolution
|   |-- repo-* sourceId -> repositories.resolveCheckoutRoot
|   `-- Other sourceId -> initialized project -> corpus binding
|-- Runtime choices
|   |-- NEW_DIAGRAM_AGENT=fake selects six runtime families
|   |   `-- Chat, mapping, diagram edit, compaction, eval, comparison
|   |-- AgentChat still receives StdioCodexConnection
|   |-- Diff workflows still receive PiDiffSessionRuntime
|   `-- lspEnabled=true -> ProjectLanguageService
|-- Returned facade retains routes and selected services
|   `-- Other services remain reachable through injected references
`-- Vite HTTP server close calls socket cleanup, then backend.dispose
    |-- Comparison runs -> eval runs -> agent chat -> diff workflows
    |-- Agent -> diagram edit runtime -> canvas bridge
    `-- Language service -> mapping/chat runtimes -> compaction
        `-- No explicit DiagramStore disposal in supplied bootstrap

Tool scope and HTTP write classification
|-- MCP explicit target, without chat binding
|   |-- Selected canvas tools lazily POST exec -> canvas.attach
|   |-- One attachment promise retained per server instance
|   |   `-- Rejection clears promise; subsequent call can retry
|   |-- Inject sessionId; reject a different supplied sessionId
|   `-- Skip attachment for changeSessionId or saved-representation search
|-- MCP chat binding
|   |-- Agent POST includes x-canvas-chat-binding
|   `-- HTTP route: string token -> callBound; otherwise -> call
|-- Vite gate runs before route dispatch
|   |-- Only /api/mapping/agent/tools/... is classified
|   |-- GET, HEAD, OPTIONS bypass classification, not route validation
|   |-- POST allowlist contains exactly six names
|   |   |-- list_repositories, get_repository_diff_hunks
|   |   |-- read_change_session_diff_tree, edit-diagram-status
|   |   `-- diagram-search, canvas-api-search
|   `-- Other classified calls need httpEnabled or a truthy header
|       `-- Presence passes this gate; binding resolution is downstream
|-- MCP readOnlyHint is a separate annotation
|   |-- Also marks list/read/read-lineage agent-context tools read-only
|   `-- Those three are absent from the HTTP POST allowlist
`-- Auxiliary eval/comparison MCP requests omit the binding header
    `-- These paths are outside the programmable tool gate

Chat visibility and stream lifetime
|-- Public projection in agentChatRoutes
|   |-- publicSession removes toolDefinitions and generationRequests
|   |-- publicGeneration removes generation.history only
|   `-- publicEvent projects snapshots, generation patches and batches
|-- SSE subscription supplies retained snapshot and later events
|   |-- Snapshot with >1 item -> partial header + one item per part
|   |   `-- Last snapshot-part sets final=true
|   |-- Completed tool text or diff >1000 characters -> shortened
|   |   |-- Text: last three lines; diffs: first three lines
|   |   `-- Each retained line capped at 240 characters
|   |-- In-progress tools stay intact
|   `-- GET sessions/{id}/items/{requestId} returns full found item
|-- Backpressure belongs to this HTTP response
|   |-- Snapshot bytes receive a separate allowance
|   |-- Successful write or drain resets allowance
|   `-- Queued bytes > allowance + 2 MiB -> destroy response
`-- Response close clears 15-second heartbeat and unsubscribes
    `-- Destroyed response after subscribe resolves also triggers cleanup

Live socket state and context data
|-- attachLiveCanvasSockets retains per-socket role and queue state
|   |-- Reader: connectionId from service.attach(workspace, document)
|   |-- Publisher: workspaceInstanceId from publish
|   `-- Another attach/publish while bound or attaching -> ALREADY_ATTACHED
|-- Reader context requests
|   |-- includeContext -> fetch context before service.attach
|   |   `-- Replace 10-second handshake timeout with 30-second timeout
|   |-- context.get requires a reader connection
|   `-- Pending fetch or undrained context -> CONTEXT_BUSY
|-- Sending preserves complete event sequence
|   |-- Existing buffered bytes >64 KiB + allowance -> close 1013
|   |-- Encoded context event >64 MiB -> close 1009
|   `-- Context bytes add allowance until send callback releases it
|-- Copy/paste and context uploads have independent option checks
|   `-- Vite sets both options from httpEnabled === true
|-- Selection HTTP read depends on service.read(connectionId)
|   |-- ETag = quoted connectionId:sequence
|   |-- If-None-Match accepts lists, weak tags and wildcard
|   `-- Matching tag -> 304; epoch/version/sequence/time headers retained
`-- Cleanup ownership
    |-- Close: clear handshake; detach reader or disconnect publisher
    |-- 15-second heartbeat: absent pong -> terminate
    `-- Disposer: clear interval, remove upgrade listener, terminate all

Evaluation dependencies and exposed projections
|-- Bootstrap connects shared generation evidence
|   |-- observeGenerations -> evalRuns.recordLegacy
|   |-- generatedCanvases.snapshot -> evalRuns.outputSnapshot
|   |-- replayLegacy / cancelLegacy -> AgentChatService
|   `-- readChangeSession -> changes.get
|-- ReferenceGenerationService depends on agentChat and evalRuns
|-- JudgementService depends on compare sessions and both run stores
|-- ExperimentService depends on evalRuns, store and context library
|-- Route-level input constraints
|   |-- Prompt snapshot: UUID requestId + name of 1..120 characters
|   |-- Prompt fork: additionally requires positive integer version
|   `-- Capture output: cellKey + changeSessionId + expectedVersion >= 0
|       `-- Calls runs.captureOutputResult; internal semantics not supplied
|-- Response projections
|   |-- GET run -> summarizeEvalRun + optional nonempty judgements
|   `-- GET history -> omit documents, return remaining timeline fields
`-- Boundaries of the pinned evidence
    |-- Eval routes show service calls, validation and HTTP status
    |-- Comparison/push/diff handlers are imported but not supplied
    `-- Their internal execution and persistence guarantees are unverified
